req.title: Create task
req.statement: The system shall create a new task and respond with HTTP 201 and the created task body when POST /tasks/ receives a valid TaskCreate payload.
expected_outcomes: response body includes id, title, completed=false

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the 'Create task' functionality of the task management API. It includes tests for positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage and mutation resilience.

tests.name: test_create_task_positive
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid TaskCreate payload.
expected: The response body contains the created task with 'completed' set to false.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "New Task", "description": "A new task to be done.", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "New Task"
assert response.json()["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_negative
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an invalid TaskCreate payload (missing title).
expected: The response status code is 422 indicating a validation error.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"description": "A task without a title.", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a TaskCreate payload having a title of maximum length (100 characters).
expected: The response body contains the created task with the exact title and 'completed' set to false.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "X" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": max_length_title, "description": "Boundary test for title length.", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == max_length_title
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
